title: Your AI chat history and AI training are not the same thing
description: Google announced Gemini will let you keep chat history while opting out of model training. Here's what each setting actually means.

scenes.sub: Google just split them in Gemini
scenes.say: Your AI chat history and AI training are two different things, and Google just split them apart in Gemini.
History is for you. It lets you scroll back through old chats. Training is for the model. It means conversations can be used to help improve future AI. Those are separate ideas.
On November sixteenth, Google announced that Gemini users can keep history on while opting out of training. It's rolling out globally over the coming weeks.
One catch. With history off, Google says chats are still kept for around two months, to respond to you, handle feedback, and keep people safe.

steps: Check how long chats are kept
scenes.say: Whatever AI app you use, check two things. What does it save, and what does it learn from? They can be separate switches, and they're worth finding. Follow Pocket Silicon for more AI explained simply.
